Checked partial source is local19c33c04ff9c473678f8747a1859cf1bcdeb306e. Tasks1–5 engineering slices are independently reviewed; Task5 real33-testGREEN covers110 output boundaries. Original approval remains valid evidence for its original scope. Successor authorization, C3/G07 acceptance, merge, revised BizTrust framework pin, BizTrust G00, runtime, release and deployment are separate decisions.
